dn24:2.20.21: aggaññañcāhaṃ bhaggava pajānāmi tañca pajānāmi tato ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāmi tañca pajānanaṃ na parāmasāmi. aparāmasato ca me paccattaññeva nibbuti viditā
dn24:2.21.1: evaṃvādiṃ kho maṃ bhaggava evamakkhāyiṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti
dn24:2.21.4: yasmiṃ samaye subhaṃ vimokkhaṃ upasampajja viharati sabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye asubhanteva sampajānātīti.
dn24:2.21.5: na kho panāhaṃ bhaggava evaṃ vadāmi
dn24:2.21.6: yasmiṃ samaye subhaṃ vimokkhaṃ upasampajja viharati sabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye asubhanteva sampajānātīti. evaṃ
dn24:2.21.8: yasmiṃ samaye subhaṃ vimokkhaṃ upasampajja viharati subhanteva tasmiṃ samaye sampajānātīti.
dn24:2.21.9: te ca viparitā ye bhagavantaṃ viparitattā dahanti bhikkhavo ca
dn24:2.21.10: evaṃpasanno ahaṃ bhante bhagavati pahoti ca me bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desituṃ yathā ahaṃ subhaṃ vimokkhaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti.
dn24:2.21.11: dukkaraṃ kho etaṃ bhaggava tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatra āyogena aññatra ācariyakena subhaṃ vimokkhaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ
dn24:2.21.12: iṅgha tvaṃ bhaggava yo ca te ayaṃ mayi pasādo tameva tvaṃ sādhukaṃ
dn24:2.21.13: anurakkhāti. sacetaṃ bhante mayā dukkaraṃ aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatra āyogena aññatra ācariyakena subhaṃ vimokkhaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ
dn24:2.21.14: yo ca me ayaṃ bhante bhagavati pasādo tamevāhaṃ sādhukamanurakkhissāmīti .
dn24:2.21.16: attamano bhaggavagotto paribbājako bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
